points: Building full-stack features end to end with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and Express.
Designing and developing REST and GraphQL APIs, with JWT-based authentication, role-based access and request validation.
Modeling data and writing efficient queries in MongoDB and PostgreSQL to keep pages and APIs fast.
Creating reusable UI components and working closely with designers and QA, following best practices for code quality, accessibility and security.
Delivered full-stack features for numerous client projects across e-commerce, fintech and healthcare domains, including a HIPAA-compliant healthcare app.
Built a role-based employee rewards portal where employees up to VPs earn points for their work and redeem them for goodies, spanning React UI, Node.js/Express APIs and the database.
Developed RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express backed by MongoDB and PostgreSQL, with authentication, authorization and error handling.
Developed scalable React applications with reusable component libraries and centralized state management, improving performance through code splitting, lazy loading and memoization.
Wrote unit, component and API tests, took part in code reviews and mentored newer team members.
